build_optimizer: build an Adam or AdamW optimizer for a QINCo model from a config object
build_scheduler: build a cosine or ReduceLROnPlateau learning rate scheduler for QINCo training
compute_MSE: compute MSE on a validation dataset with optional encode and decode timing
train_qinco: run the full QINCo training loop with optimizer, scheduler, and evaluation
QincoTrainTask: run a QINCo training task end-to-end including data loading, model init, and training
